newsitem.title: FINLAND: KEMIRA SAYS COMPLETES FIBRE UNIT SALE.
newsitem.headline: KEMIRA SAYS COMPLETES FIBRE UNIT SALE.

text.p: Finnish chemicals group Kemira Oy said on Monday it had reached final agreement on the previously announced sale of its viscose fibre business to Indonesian group PT Inti Indorayon Utama.
"According to the contract the entire share capital of Kemira Fibres Oy was transferred to Indorayon today," Kemira said in a statement, but did not disclose the sale price.
Kemira said on May 12 that it was in talks with the Indonesian group on the sale of the fibres unit.
Kemira Fibres Oy's net sales for 1997 are estimated at 590 million markka and it has about 430 employees, Kemira said.
The effects of the sale had been included in the financial statements for the first four months of the year, published on June 9, 1997, it said.
